note: Status is never stored here: it is computed by scripts/check_controls.py from what exists and (with --run) from what passes.

controls.statement: Tenant evidence is a hash chain: an edit, deletion or reorder is detected and every dependent decision fails closed.
controls.limits: The chain is local to the OLA database: whoever controls the database and the code can rewrite it consistently. EC-06 is the external anchor for that.

controls.statement: Server-only record types (identity.*, firewall.*, cfr.*, pipeline.*) cannot be written through the public evidence API.
controls.limits: A holder of the database or the server process is outside this control.

controls.statement: The pipeline gate fails closed: only a fully verified chain with human approval is VERIFIED; unknown states are never upgraded.
controls.limits: A VERIFIED verdict says the process was followed and evidenced, not that the answer is correct (see EC-07).

controls.statement: A finished session is anchored in the tenant chain; any later change of envelopes, artifacts or final.json is detected.
controls.limits: The anchor proves consistency with what was sealed, not truth of the content.

controls.statement: Sessions can be Ed25519-signed and verified against a key pinned out of band.
controls.limits: The operator key (F03) is not generated in this repository's CI; sessions in CI use test keys.

controls.statement: The chain head can be stamped by an RFC 3161 time-stamp authority and verified offline.
controls.limits: Tested against a locally generated TSA; no production TSA was contacted. A stamp proves the head existed at the time, nothing more.

controls.statement: A PASS becomes VERIFIED only if the judge was measured on both sides (false accepts and accepted correct answers); qualification can only downgrade.
controls.limits: MEASURED: no judge qualifies on the v2 set (llama3.2:3b 6/72 false accepts, llama3.1:8b and qwen2.5:7b 0/67 correct accepted, gemma2:9b 50/72 false accepts), so the control currently withholds VERIFIED from every judge. Off unless OLA_JUDGE_QUALIFICATION_FILE is set.

controls.statement: Ambient IGOR never promotes a result; in enforce mode an answer is released only by an observed, qualified, different judge.
controls.limits: Enforce has no judge it can accept today (see EC-07).

controls.statement: Agent Firewall: every decision is evidence; a permit is single-use, bound to the action and to the pinned policy; a review needs a human approval.
controls.limits: The firewall decides and records; it does not sandbox the action. Enforcement depends on the caller honouring the permit.

controls.statement: Agent and approver identity: Ed25519 principals enrolled in the chain; requests are signed, bound to purpose, tenant and subject, single-use and time-limited.
controls.limits: Not an identity provider: enrolment is gated by one operator token; a stolen private key is a valid principal until revoked. Default mode is off.

controls.statement: CFR: runner results are signed and scored by the server; the runner's own score is never read; only PASS ranks; unknown assertions never pass.
controls.limits: The runner attests the metrics; a lying runner can sign false numbers. Weights are uncalibrated. Docker/k3d modes are not provided.

controls.statement: Jev decision fabric is advisory: off by default, never executes, size-limited, malformed answers are BLOCKED and recorded.
controls.limits: UNKNOWN: the quality of Jev's decisions has not been measured (no provider key in CI; the jev-quality job reports NOT_PROVEN).

controls.statement: Single-record verification returns PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN from a recomputed hash and the chain, never from a stored verdict.
controls.limits: Verifies integrity of the record, not the truth of its payload.

controls.statement: The evidence graph gives no execution authority: it can represent a decision-to-evidence path but cannot act on it.
controls.limits: Graph facts are only as good as what was written into them.

controls.statement: A CFR result can be cross-checked by an independent witness principal; a witness can only lower the result, and a required manifest without a confirming witness never passes.
controls.limits: The witness is only as independent as its deployment: in local-process mode participant and witness share a machine, so the manifest of the shipped scenario keeps `required` false. Restarts and blast radius stay runner-attested.
